_diff_from_v2: Added n1d (managed-docs scanner) + actions a18/a19: the signal layer can now also read a per-project, CONFIGURABLE managed-docs folder (e.g. agent-ui's .claude/docs/ with its typed ADR/PRD/SPEC/LLD/ticket corpus) and a named allowlist of pre-vetted document TYPES/sections (a ratified ADR Decision, a closed ticket's Findings, a ratified SPEC/PRD clause, an existing reference doc) as a second candidate source alongside live-conversation frequency/impact detection, AND as calibration exemplars that sharpen n1a/n1b's admission bar ('this is what good knowledge already looks like in this project').

This directly operationalizes break-down-problem's own documented judgment-layer gap (its 'Scope of the gate' note: a ratified ADR Decision that never became an action has nothing to leave UNHOSTED, so a manifest can pass clean while the need ships nothing — 'catch that upstream with the ADR-Decision -> action completeness review, a judgement step, not this gate'). n1d/a18 is that review, now a first-class signal source rather than a manual afterthought.

Per-project config assumption (stated, correctable): the managed-docs folder path and the document-type allowlist are NOT hardcoded — each project (agent-ui, nonoun-plugins, a future repo) names its own, consistent with the portable/project-agnostic scope decided earlier. A managed-docs candidate still passes through the SAME n6a->n3a->n2a->n2b confirmation gate as every other candidate — this is an additional SOURCE, not a bypass of requirement 1 (never auto-author).

nodes.label: knowledge-harvesting system
signal layer
frequency detector ("third telling" heuristic)
impact/blast-radius detector

managed-docs scanner (reads a configured per-project docs folder + a named allowlist of pre-vetted document types/sections: ratified ADR Decisions, closed-ticket Findings, ratified SPEC/PRD clauses, existing reference docs)
candidate assembler (quote + source + count/impact + dates)
cross-project routing layer
project-substrate map (which repo/plugin owns this fact)
placement + authoring layer
placement resolver (PROPOSES: new skill vs extend reference vs new reference-file vs reject-duplicate, plus a versioning plan) — tentative, subject to user override at n2b
confirmation layer
candidate summarizer (candidate + PROPOSED placement/versioning plan -> a concrete, decidable question)
AskUserQuestion gate (confirm / override / skip the proposed plan) — no write happens without a pass through here, regardless of which signal source produced the candidate
content author (SKILL.md/reference/routing-corpus/evals + citation capture) — only runs on a confirmed plan
corpus validation layer
structural gate (release_gate.py — includes the handle-convention/dangling-reference checks, G5+G8)
independent reviewer dispatch (skill-checker / plugin-checker, generator≠critic) — runs on gate-clean content only
routing gate (blind judge simulation, check-routing) — runs on the final, post-review descriptions
staleness layer
trigger integration (a concrete, user-invoked entry point — e.g. a slash command run periodically — never an assumed background process)
re-verify trigger (checks recorded citations still hold, once invoked via n5c)
stale-entry resolution (re-confirm with user before edit/retire)

actions.label: detect a repeated correction/fact crossing the frequency admission bar
detect a high-impact/blast-radius fact even on first occurrence
scan a configured managed-docs folder for pre-vetted document types/sections as a direct candidate source
use the managed-docs folder's existing high-quality entries as calibration exemplars, sharpening the frequency/impact admission bar
assemble a candidate record (quote, source, count/impact score, dates) from whichever signal source produced it
propose which project's substrate a candidate belongs to
propose placement: new skill vs new reference file vs extend existing reference vs reject as duplicate
propose a versioning plan: in-place edit vs a new dated entry, never silently mutate a finalized claim
summarize the candidate AND its proposed placement/versioning plan into a question the user can decide on
ask the user via AskUserQuestion to confirm, override, or skip the proposed plan before any write happens
author/update the actual SKILL.md, reference, routing-corpus, and evals content per the confirmed plan
record each cited claim's exact source (file:line, commit/date) at authoring time
run the structural gate (release_gate.py, incl. handle-convention checks) on the affected plugin
dispatch an independent reviewer before treating a candidate change as landed
run the blind routing simulation on the affected plugin's final descriptions
wire the re-verify trigger to a concrete, user-invoked entry point rather than an assumed background process
re-check a recorded citation still holds, once the trigger is invoked
on a broken/stale citation, ask the user again before editing or retiring the entry

edges.why: the managed-docs folder's existing entries calibrate what counts as 'good knowledge,' sharpening the frequency detector's threshold before it fires
the same calibration exemplars sharpen the impact/blast-radius detector's threshold
a candidate mined directly from a ratified doc (e.g. an ADR Decision) still needs assembling into the same candidate-record shape as a conversation-detected one
the assembled candidate is needed before proposing which project's substrate it belongs to
the target project must be known before proposing where within that corpus the entry lands
the summarizer needs the proposed placement/versioning plan to build a concrete, decidable question rather than a vague yes/no
the AskUserQuestion dispatch needs the summarized question as its input
authoring must not start until the user has confirmed (or overridden) the specific proposed plan
the structural gate runs against authored content, and needs it to exist first
reviewer attention is reserved for content that already passes the cheap deterministic gate, not a pre-gate draft
the routing simulation should measure the final, post-review descriptions, since review may change wording that affects routing
a citation must be recorded during authoring before it can ever be re-verified later
the re-verify trigger only runs through its concrete invocation point; the entry point must be wired before the check logic can fire
a re-verify trigger firing on a broken citation is what feeds the stale-entry resolution step
